answer_1.quote: We introduce the novel task of automated image contextualization. Given an image, a model must identify its meta-context using the image content and evidence from the open web.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to the 5 Pillars questions (Provenance, Source, Date, Location, Motivation).

answer_2.quote: Source expects free-form answers, evaluated using the RougeL and Meteor metrics. ... Motivation with BertScore (BertS) to measure the semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 test images and manually categorize the predictions of multimodal zero-shot GPT4.
answer_4.guideline: Categorizing predictions into predefined categories: correct answer, partially correct answer, no answer with evidence available, no answer with no evidence available, wrong answer based on text, wrong answer based on image, content filtering error, predict misinformation.
